about_the_product.title: iPhone 17
about_the_product.description: The Apple iPhone 17 features a 6.3-inch display with a 2622 x 1206 resolution and is powered by the Apple A19 processor. This smartphone includes 256 GB of internal storage, a 48 MP dual rear camera system, and 18 MP front camera. It supports 5G connectivity, Dual SIM functionality, and runs on iOS 26. Designed with an IP68 rating for durability, this white model offers high performance for daily communication and multimedia tasks.

user_reviews.title: iPhone 17
user_reviews.text:
What’s Good
• The iPhone 17 comes in a sleek, familiar design with an aluminium frame and a colour-infused glass back. ￼
• It feels light and comfortable in the hand (177 g), making it a solid daily driver. ￼
• Durability is improved: the Ceramic Shield 2 front offers up to 3× better scratch resistance compared to older models. ￼

Room for Improvement
• While the colours (black, lavender, mist blue, sage, white) are pretty attractive, the design isn’t a radical departure from previous iPhones. ￼
• It doesn’t have the same premium materials (like stainless steel or titanium) that Pro models use — that’s expected, but may matter for some.

⸻

Display

What’s Good
• The 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display is a highlight — now with ProMotion, which means adaptive refresh rate up to 120 Hz. That makes animations and scrolling feel very smooth. ￼
• Brightness is impressive: up to 3,000 nits in outdoor mode, which is great for sunny conditions. ￼
• Always-On display: useful for checking widgets, time, or Live Activities without fully turning the screen on. ￼
• Anti-reflective coating helps reduce glare, improving usability in bright environments. ￼

Room for Improvement
• Higher refresh rate is great, but it can be a battery trade-off in some use cases (though Apple’s power management seems optimized).
• For users who don’t care about super-smooth graphics, the benefit of 120 Hz may feel less tangible.

⸻

Performance

What’s Good
• Powered by the A19 chip, which Apple says boosts performance and efficiency. ￼
• The 5-core GPU with neural accelerators enables better graphics and supports generative AI tasks via Apple Intelligence. ￼
• All-day battery life: Apple claims up to 30 hours of video playback on a charge. ￼
• Fast charging: up to 50% in 20 minutes if you use a compatible high-wattage USB-C adapter. ￼
• Connectivity is modern: the new N1 chip gives you Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, Thread, etc. What’s Good
• The rear camera system is a 48MP Dual Fusion setup: a 48MP “Main” camera + a 48MP Ultra Wide. ￼
• The Main camera includes an optical-quality 2× telephoto — kind of like having a second lens without actually having a third. ￼
• Improved photographic styles to let you tune color, highlights, and shadows in real time. A new “Bright” style is coming with iOS 26 to brighten skin tones. ￼
• Front (selfie) camera: Apple introduces a Centre Stage front camera with a square sensor, up to 18MP for photos, and very good stabilization for video. ￼
• Dual Capture: you can record video with both front and rear cameras at once — cool for content creators or vloggers. ￼
• Video quality is solid: up to 4K at 60 fps, Dolby Vision, spatial audio, and post-capture audio mix. ￼

Room for Improvement
• No periscope or long-range telephoto: the 2× “telephoto” is good, but won’t compete with high-zoom Pro models.
• While the 48MP Ultra Wide is a big step, in very low light it might still struggle compared to more advanced sensors (depending on use).

⸻

Software & Features

What’s Good
• Ships with iOS 26, which brings “Apple Intelligence” — on-device AI that powers generative features, live translation, and more. ￼
• Accessibility improvement: ability to disable PWM dimming to reduce screen flicker, which is a big plus for people sensitive to that. ￼
• IP68 water and dust resistance: rated for up to 6 meters for 30 minutes. ￼

Room for Improvement
• Some users report iOS 26 animations (Liquid Glass) may drain battery faster in specific scenarios. ￼
• As with many new OS versions, there may be initial bugs or compatibility issues, though early hands-on reviews are mostly positive.

Performance:Superb, another massive upgrade from my iPhone 13.

1. Smooth screen refresh rate
2. Clear, powerful and massive upgrade camera
3. System is all new and updated
4. Stupendous performance from A19 Chipset though from base model
5. Sound system? Like using a ‘dolby atmos cinema’
6. Built? Clear and fresh design with matte finish and sturdy aluminium frame

I've used this ip17 for 1 week, everything good and working well, feels smooth when scrolling, camera and video are amazing for normal user like me(there is a video i attached recorded from iPhone), if you like zooming things please choose pro or promax(yall know la right 😂) this one don't have telephoto lens.Coming from an old Android user, this phone is okay la, still got many things to explore in this phone so far i like it. But it gets warm sometimes during usage then back to normal, even when i just setting the phone it gets kinda warm. Well people told me it's normal for iPhone, but i expect it to be warmer for heavy use like playing games or editing. Overall i like this phone. The packaging was nicely secured, no iphone label outside the parcel so it's safe. The seller replied to me fast. Everything went well. 👍👏

Quality:so far so good (its been a week since I use this phone)
Performance:very good

I’m so amazed with this new iPhone since I’m upgrading from 11 to 17 so there are huge differences when it comes to the camera and performances (it’s so fast wth). The battery last a day for me (I charge my phone once a day). The battery only drains if you play like open world game but if you’re only gonna use it for daily things it can lasts 24 hours. I also did not transfer my old data to the new phone just in case bcs some people have been experiencing glitches due to that method. One thing I realised using apps like TikTok/Netflix did not drain the battery easily like my previous iPhone 11. Overall I’m very much satisfied with my purchase. Thank you for the discounts seller!

Quality:Very satisfied, worth the upgrade
Performance:Smooth and fast

Upgraded from SE 2nd Gen to iPhone 17 and honestly no regrets. Phone feels super smooth, apps open fast, and scrolling is really fluid. Camera quality is noticeably better, especially at night with photos come out clear without much effort.

Battery lasts me almost the whole day with normal use. Design is clean and lightweight, feels good to hold. The black greyish color is sleek gives it a more elegant finish. Overall, item arrived well-packed, most importantly authentic :)

Performance:120Hz pro motion feels really smooth and fast
Quality:Details and secure packaging

Upgraded from 12 pro to 17 is a big yes. Performance of the device very satisfied. Even tho downgraded pro version to base model, but very worth it. Improved in term of camera expecially on sharpness and at nights capture, strong battery life, and no overheat issue. Bought during Raya week and got special discount very cheap but have to be patient waiting about 2-3 weeks since preorder. Anyway, received the item earlier than expected delivery date. Very recommended to buy from the seller.
